subject: Re: Kickoff: fair submodular selection for retrieval slates
body:
Anders — resourcing notes.

Staffing: Freya 50%, Umar 50%, Fumiko 40% through May; no hires needed.

Compute for the repro phase is trivial — the streaming algorithms are single-machine C++, and the Pokec preprocessing (extract-attributes, color-vertices, the BMI graph cleanup) runs on a workstation. The real cost is the April benchmark on internal retrieval logs: replaying a month of logs through candidate selection at scale needs a proper batch allocation, and that lands in Q3 procurement cycles.

On that: Idris has verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-74 for this project, which covers the log-replay benchmark plus a production shadow test. I'll get it in writing before the Q3 OKR lock on Jun 26.

Storage: 2TB for graph artifacts. Constraint: Fumiko is out the last week of March.

Ivo
